comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus securing a carton to a cart with a bungee.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen handling and granular-flow control versus stretching cord and seating hooks under tension.
comparison.success_condition: Media recovered through apertures with every washer retained and no spill, versus two hooks seated and carton retained through a cart-motion test.
comparison.reason: The shared bimanual load handling is generic; the tested mechanisms and outcomes are different.
